zh: 把方口杯里的红豆，倒进<target_cup>里，倒半杯
用方口杯给<target_cup>倒半杯红豆
把方口杯里的红豆倒一些到<target_cup>里，倒到半杯就停
拿起方口杯和<target_cup>，往<target_cup>里倒半杯红豆，再把两个杯子放回桌上
en: Pour the red beans from the square cup into <target_cup> until it is half full.
Fill <target_cup> halfway with red beans from the square cup.
Use the square cup to pour half a cup of red beans into <target_cup>.
Pick up both cups, pour red beans into <target_cup> until it is half full, then put both cups back.
Pour about half a cup of red beans into <target_cup>.
